reviews.raw:
{
  "verdict": "APPROVED",
  "summary": "The implementation correctly integrates all requested fixes and adheres to PLAN-B75. Robust handling of edge cases (NaN volume, missing session data) is verified, and look-ahead bias is properly prevented in Z-score and rolling calculations. Tests provide explicit coverage for the recently applied fixes.",
  "findings": [],
  "coverage": "High. Tests cover contract roll-over logic, TAIFEX tick parsing, multi-session aggregation (including the 13:30/13:45 auction bar merging), look-ahead prevention in features, and the retail ratio calculation logic. Fixes for NaN volume and missing night highs/lows are specifically unit-tested.",
  "limitations": "Backfill relies on external sources (Yahoo/FinMind/TAIFEX/CNYES); while retry logic exists, downtime in those APIs would delay historical data population."
}
